newsitem.title: NORWAY: Aker Maritime in 280 mln NOK drilling deal.
newsitem.headline: Aker Maritime in 280 mln NOK drilling deal.

text.p: Maritime Hydraulics, a subsidiary of Aker Maritime ASA offshore group, has signed a letter of intent with Smedvig ASA for the supply of drilling equipment worth about 280 million crowns, Oslo Bourse said on Monday.
The equipment would be installed on a ship that Smedvig and Statoil, or Den norske stats oljeselskap AS, will use for drilling of wells, a statement said.
The equipment is meant to be delivered on March 31, 1998.
Aker Maritime is majority-owned by industrial group Aker RGI ASA.
Earlier on Monday, Smedvig announced it had signed a letter of intent with Statoil for running the ship, which is now under construction.
